databases.name: Products
writeRules: update and soft-delete match Id + Version + IsDeleted=false
zero affected rows is concurrency conflict

databases.name: Orders

tables.name: OrderIntegrationOutbox
indexes: claim index on NextAttemptAt, CreatedOn, Id where ParkedAt is null

atomicCommit: verify aggregate Version equals database MAX(Version) or zero
append every pending event with contiguous versions
databases.rollback: Any failure before transaction commit rolls back stream, projection, and outbox together.
relay: lease eligible rows with owner token
publish using stable outbox Id and AggregateId partition key

databases.name: Inventory

tables.name: InventoryIntegrationOutbox

columns.Id: UUID PK; OperationId for reservation, UUID v7 for ordinary stock commands
columns.Attempts: INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK Attempts >= 0

indexes: claim index on NextAttemptAt, CreatedOn, Id where PublishedAt and ParkedAt are null
tables.evolution: Before Kafka plus RabbitMQ dual broadcast, add per-destination delivery state; one PublishedAt cannot represent independent broker completion.

normalAggregateRules: find by product through read port and reload aggregate by identity
create producer-owned event plus UUID v7 message ID and ProductId N partition key
IInventoryStockOutbox updates state only where Stock equals expected stock and inserts outbox in one local transaction
dispatch and clear local domain events only after durable commit
reservationTransaction: call capability-specific IInventoryReservationOutbox; no generic UoW or transaction lifecycle is exposed to Application
insert OperationId claim with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
if already claimed read stored outcome and compare ProductId+Quantity
on success invoke the Application-supplied message factory and stage ProductStockDecreasedIntegrationEvent with Id=OperationId and PartitionKey=ProductId formatted N
commit state, outcome, and outbox once
databases.rollback: Any reserve, outbox-stage, or commit failure rolls back stock, terminal outcome, and outbox together.
replayRules: same identity and payload returns stored outcome with WasAlreadyProcessed=true
same successful identity reuses the existing outbox Id and does not add a row
same identity and different payload returns OperationIdentityConflict without stock mutation
terminal failures remain terminal on replay even if later stock changes
relay: lease unpublished and unparked rows with owner token
publish using stable Id and stored PartitionKey
PublishedForDays with a positive PublishedRetentionDays prunes only published rows
databases.applicationBoundary: Outbox capability ports are Application-owned; local transaction or Unit of Work is an Infrastructure implementation detail.
databases.dualBrokerTarget: Current schema and relay are single-destination. Kafka plus RabbitMQ requires a child delivery ledger keyed by MessageId plus Destination with independent attempts, locks, PublishedAt, ParkedAt, and LastError.

acceptance: Concurrency and transaction failure paths are tested against PostgreSQL.
A blocked database test is not a pass.
